title: Armadillo Aerospace - Mod free flight, engine restart, 4 views
summary: A four-pane view of Armadillo Aerospace's Mod vehicle on a June 2010 boosted hop. The flight includes engine shutdown, drogue chute deployment, an engine restart and a safe landing.
why: Cited as an example of impressive amateur-scale rocket work, and as a vertical-landing test that predates and rivals SpaceX's Grasshopper.

quote.text: this [1] test by Armadillo was more impressive in my opinion for the additional complexity involved
